notes:
Topline: SMB SaaS maker of a lightweight writing & knowledge assistant embedded in their CMS. Self-serve sign-up, testing hosted API. Main topic: data privacy + retention. Short bullets below.

Discovery call 2026-02-20 (30m) — Jordan + Priya. Attendees: CEO Maya Ortiz, Eng lead Ben Carter.
  - Use: in-app writing suggestions, document summarization, search re-ranking for help articles. Low QPS: ~5-20 reqs/min initially. Latency target: <500ms median for user-facing completions. Cost sensitivity: high (seed-stage economics).
  - Primary concern: we must not retain customer prompts longer than 30 days and need a clear opt-out for end-users. Quote from CEO: "If PII gets logged we get regulatory headache — need delete on request."
  - Asked: does Redwood Hosted API store prompt/response logs by default? Are logs accessible to human reviewers? How long are call logs retained? Is there a programmatic delete/TTL? Any end-user opt-out API?
  - They prefer hosted_api for speed to market; may move to Dedicated later if volume justifies and stricter controls needed.

Security follow-up 2026-03-01 — we sent security FAQ + retention whitepaper (drive link above).
  - Action: attach redact/PII guidance + recommended client-side hashing.
  - They requested a short diagram of where logs live in hosted mode and who can access them (requested by Ben).

Sandbox tests 2026-03-04 — they spun up a free-key sandbox.
  - Initial run flagged ~42 prompts containing emails/SSNs in test data. Dev note: want auto-redaction suggestions and confirmation that Redwood won't surface those prompts to third-party reviewers.
  - They opened INF-332 asking: can we configure 'no-persist' flag per request?

Current status (2026-03-12): discovery ongoing. AE has provided pricing card (self-serve) and link to retention policy. Security wants a short POA: 1) TTL options (7/30/90 days), 2) API-driven deletion endpoint, 3) statement on human review.

Other notes:
  - Not asking for SSO/SAML yet — SMB, small team.
  - Interested in Optimize suggestions (batching to save cost) but primary ask remains privacy.
  - Quote from Ben (eng lead): "We need a simple knob — either logs are off or we keep them short and deletable."

Next steps (AE): provide an engineering-facing doc showing: retention TTLs, delete API example, exact fields retained (headers, prompt bodies, model outputs), and a short security one-pager confirming no human access unless explicit escalation. Schedule 15m demo week of 2026-03-16 to walk devs through integration and deletion flows.

POC success criteria: can integrate hosted API in sandbox with 'no-persist' or TTL=7d, run 500 user prompts without PII leak, and receive clear SLA around retention for billing approval.
